Hi Samira / Jordan —

Thanks again for the discovery session today — helpful to understand the three core requirements you called out: low-latency inference for patient-facing features, on-prem / VPC deployment for PHI isolation, and deterministic cost targets for peak traffic. To keep momentum, we'd like to book a focused ML/Infra deep-dive (60–90 minutes) with our SE + infra leads so we can: 

- Walk your architecture and production constraints
- Validate deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC on your infra)
- Surface perf/cost tradeoffs (batching, quantization, caching)
- Align an initial mutual action plan for PoC scope and timeline

Proposed 75-minute slots (please pick one or suggest alternatives):
- Wed, Oct 6 — 10:00–11:15 PT (13:00–14:15 ET)
- Thu, Oct 7 — 14:00–15:15 ET (11:00–12:15 PT)
- Fri, Oct 8 — 09:00–10:15 PT (12:00–13:15 ET)

Requested attendees from your side: SRE/Platform lead, Security/Compliance lead, and a product manager who owns the patient-facing flows. From Redwood: Priyom (SE) and Laura (Solutions Eng) will join and own the technical runbook + preflight checklist.

I've attached a one-page mutual action plan (MPA_ClearPath.pdf) and a short pre-call checklist (tdx-precall-checklist.docx) — the checklist details environment access we typically request (sample logs, model size/peaks, VPC network egress rules). Also linking our HubSpot record for this opportunity: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/clearpath-health

If you confirm a slot I’ll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and a short pre-read to make the session productive.

Thanks —
Ben
